description.item1: Implemented microservices using Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, and PostgreSQL for different onboarding processes such as the purchase of new products offered by the bank, including bank accounts, credit cards, and personal or business insurance.
description.item2: Took over the biometric application, managing the front-end and back-end of the component, including the integration of new biometric authentication flows with Incode.
description.item3: Integrated the Application Performance Monitoring system provided by Elastic into various Angular projects for improved monitoring of the application.
description.item4: Created components and pages for new products, as well as managed and optimized existing ones.
description.item5: With the help of GitHub Copilot, developed unit tests using Jest and JUnit.
description.item6: Provided incident support involving analysis, root cause reporting, and solution development when required using Jira Cloud.
description.item7: Continuous development and integration workflows using tools such as Jira Cloud, OpenShift, and GitHub.

description.item1: Participated in the migration of a towing and vehicle repair management system using ASP.NET MVC and C#.
description.item2: Developed front-end views and interfaces using Bootstrap and JavaScript.
description.item3: Contributed to back-end development by migrating legacy system functionality and implementing client-requested improvements.

description.item1: Freelance multimedia web project focused on creative experimentation and 3D graphics development. I was part of the 3D graphics environment development team, which was built using the Three.js library and the React.js framework.

During my time at DVRV, I took part in different tasks related to Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality. These tasks involved testing augmented reality solutions and developing a mini tutorial for the Oculus Quest VR headset using Unity.
A personal project that, along with friends and classmates, was aimed at video game development using the Unity engine. During this time, we completed two projects:

sub.item1:
Caro:
A game developed for a contest at our university in which we won first place. A PC game featuring four mini-games and a short but narrative-driven story.
sub.item2:
Save the Aliens:
Developed during a seminar at the Center of Digital Culture (CCD) in Mexico City.
Aimed at mobile devices. A skill-based mobile game in which players rescue aliens while attempting to beat their high scores.

description.item1: Developed a web-based management system for a high school. I designed and built the database while also contributing to back-end development using PHP. This was a project developed for the class of Software Engineering; five teams delivered solutions, and, among all the projects, my team's solution was chosen as the best.
